Commentary.Commentary: So that concludes the first game! Afghanistan win it comfortably and take a 1-0 lead in the 3-match T20I series. The next game is going to be a do-or-die for the Irishmen. They would look to improve their bowling and bounce back hard. Whereas the hosts would look to build on this victory. The second game takes place on 10th March at 1400 local time (0830 GMT). Till then, take care! Cheers!

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai feels that the wicket was looking good throughout, which made batting easy for them. Opines that the opposition fell short of 25-30 runs on a deck such as this which favoured the batsmen. Adds that the first game is always important in any series and he is really happy to win it.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that his team didn't build on the start they got. Praises the Afghan batsmen by saying that they played well and struck the ball cleanly. He feels that his run out changed the momentum of their innings. Feels that they could have got to 180 easily and also that the bowling could have been a bit better. Ends up by saying that it's just the first match and there were a lot of positives to take from it.

Man of the Match, Samiullah Shenwari thanks the almighty for his performance today. Applauds his coach and the skipper for giving him the confidence when he needed it the most. Adds that he would like to keep up his performance level high. Ends by saying he enjoyed his batting today.

None of the Irish bowlers were that effective as they hardly could keep the runs in check. Kevin O'Brien managed to get a wicket but he was hammered all round the park, conceding 52 off his 4-overs quota. By the time Stuart Thompson and Craig Young chipped in with a wicket each, the game had already tilted in the favour of the hosts.

Shenwari came in next and started off in the fourth gear directly as he hammered three boundaries in the first three balls and then 56 runs off only 36 balls. Mohammad Shahzad also batted well smashing 47 off 41 balls. The top order took the game out of the opposition's hands and skipper Stanikzai walked in to see his team through to the finish line.

An entertaining performance by the Afghanistani batsmen help them to take a lead of 1-0 in the 3-match T20I series. They were on top of the game from the very first over. The openers managed to get their team to a flying start where they scored 51 runs before losing Najeeb Tarakai on the last ball of the fifth over.

SIX! Finishes it off in style! Full and in the line of the stumps, Shafiqullah kneels down and slogs it way over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. What a way to win the match! AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 6 WICKETS AND WITH 2 OVERS TO SPARE!
Shafiqullah is the next man in.

OUT! With just a run needed to win, Nabi looks to finish it in style. Full delivery, angling into the pads, Nabi clips it uppishly. Dockrell at short mid-wicket takes another good catch to his left. Nabi has to walk back!
Full on middle and off, dug out to long on for a single. SCORES ARE LEVEL!
Another back of a length delivery, dragged to deep square leg for a single.
Short delivery, pulled on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Stanikzai sways at it and ends up missing!
Craig Young is back for a bowl.
Outside off, played to point for a single.
Pitched outside off, AS misses his punch!
Mohammad Nabi walks out.

OUT! Shenwari departs in the process of finishing the match with a glory shot! Slower one on leg, Shenwari gets ahead a touch and looks to whip it. Ends up chipping it high in the air. Dockrell at long on, judges the ball well, grabs it and just when he thinks he is crossing, he lofts the ball in air, comes back in and then pouches it safely. The umpire have a check upstairs and the replays confirm that the catch is clean. A sensational innings for Shenwari comes to and end!
The umpires have gone upstairs to check if the catch off Shenwari is clean or not.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Again it's full and angling down leg, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Leg bye! Full and angling into the pads, SS misses his flick. Gets it off the pads to short fine leg for a leg bye!
Stuart Thompson is back into the attack.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over! It's full and outside off, the Afghan skipper kneels down and slogs it straight down the ground. Both the long on and the long off fielders get across but fail to cut it down as the ball goes on one bounce and into the stands. 26 runs off the over! Just 7 needed more to win!
Wide! This time it's wide outside off, Asghar goes after it but misses. Wilson appeals for caught behind but the umpire spreads his arms to signal wide. Third wide of the over!

FOUR! In the air but safe and through to the fence! Length delivery, angling in, Stanikzai goes for the pull. Ends up top edging it over the keeper's head in the no man's land. The ball bounces a couple of times and crosses the fence.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Shenwari once again looks to clip it but misses. This time Wilson behind the stumps does extremely well to collect the ball. Some keeping that!

Five Wides! Down the leg side, Shenwari looks to clip it on its way but misses. It's way out of the keeper's reach too and goes through to the fine leg fence. Poor delivery that! 16 runs off the over already!
FOUR! Whatta shot! Fuller on middle and leg, clipped powerfully through widish mid on for a boundary.
Leg bye! Angling down leg, AS misses his flicks, gets off the thigh pad, down the leg side for a leg bye.
SIX! Smoked that! Full and angling into the stumps, Stanikzai kneels down and slogs it over mid-wicket. It's hit high and handsome and gets it over the fence for a biggie!
Kevin O'Brien is called back to bowl his final over.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single. 34 runs required off 30 deliveries!
Punched to long on for a single.
Angling into the pads, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Short again, punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Shortish delivery, sliding in, punched to long on for a single. Gets to his 2nd T20I fifty with that!
FOUR! Down the leg side, swept fine down the leg side for a boundary. Poor delivery that!
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to point.
The Afghanistan skipper Asghar Stanikzai makes his way to the middle.

OUT! Bull's eye! Angling into the pads, clipped to short mid-wicket. After getting a start, Shahzad stops for a moment. However, Shenwari runs through, Shahzad has to oblige. Dockrell there hurls a throw at the striker's end and hits. Shahzad is far away from his crease and has to make his way back!
FOUR! Full outside off, SS muscles it down the ground for a boundary. No stopping that!
Another pull shot on the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery, dragged behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Shahzad camps back and punches it on the up through covers. Porterfield fails to stop it with his dive on the right but fails to get hand to it. A single taken!
Shahzad runs it down to long on for a single.
Shahzad stays deep in his crease and defends it.

NOT OUT! Down the leg side, Shenwari clips it towards short fine leg for a single. The fielder picks it up and throws it at the non-striker's end. The bowler collects the ball and dislodges the bail. They appeal for a run out. The umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Shenwari was well inside the crease.
The umpires have gone upstairs to see if Shenwari made his ground or not at the bowler's end!
Floated around off, Shahzad goes for a slog. Gets an inside edge through the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Shahzad camps back and cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Short into the pads, Shahzad comes down the track and pushes it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
It has gone overcast out there and as a result the floodlights are switched on now!
Angling into the pads, Shahzad clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single. 48 runs needed off 48 balls.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Shahzad lets it through to the keeper. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Full this time by Thompson, Shenwari gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the cover region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Shahzad punches it through covers for a single.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Shenwari still tries to reach it. Too wide for him, even the keeper could not collect. Bye is taken. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Down the leg side, Shahzad clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Shenwari eases it towards long off for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Shenwari pushes it back to the bowler.
Stuart Thompson is introduced into the attack!
Shahzad gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it. 73 runs required off the last 10 overs!
Another sweep but this time the ball goes towards the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
50-run stand between Shahzad and Shenwari!

SIX! Down the leg side, Shenwari smells the poor line and slog sweeps it brutally over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. He is toying with the bowlers. 100 up for Afghanistan! As well as the 50-run stand!
Floated outside off, Shenwari punches it towards the cover region off the back foot.
SIX! Short and wide outside off, Shenwari stays deep in his crease and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That ball was bowled to hit!
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Angling into the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Shenwari goe sback in his crease and punches it back to the bowler.
Wide outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Pushed gently on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Shahzad lofts it on the up over mid off. The long off fielder looks to cut it down but doesn't give his cent percent. The ball crosses the ropes!
Kevin O'Brien is back into the attack.

So after the delay, we finally have the last delivery. Another slider, Shahzad prods forward in defence, gets an inside edge onto the pads and towards short fine leg. A single taken! Good over for Ireland! Just 2 from it!

There is a slight delay. Umpire miscalculated the number of balls in the ninth over. Kevin O'Brien got ready for the 10th over. The scorer got it corrected and Mulder was called back to complete his over.

Once again it's a slider, sliding down leg, Mohammad looks to play it off the back foot but gets beaten once again.  Is rapped on the pad and there's a loud appeal but turned down again! Going down leg is what the umpire indicates!

Shout for lbw! Sliding into the pads, Shahzad looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten and gets hit on the pads. The fielding side appeal but the umpire says not out, indicating that the ball is sliding down leg.
Sliding down leg, clipped to short fine leg. The fielder there hurls a throw at the striker's end. Wilson looks to deflect it but misses.
Short delivery around off, MS camps back to pull but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Worked down the leg side for a single.
SIX! Once again Shahzad uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and clobbers it over long on. Connects well this time and gets it over the fence. Good end to the over!
Defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Dropped! Tossed up delivery, on middle and leg, Shahzad uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid on. Doesn't time it well. The ball heads straight to O'Brien at long on. He looks to take it with a reverse cup, stretching his hands high above. However, he fails to grab it. The batsmen run through for a single. The umpires check it the ball crosses the fence for a boundary. The replays show that O'Brien did well to keep it in. How costly will this chance prove?
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
George Dockrell is back into the attack.
Tossed up on middle and leg, eased on to long on for a single.
Fires it quicker on off, SS is hurried by the pace. Does well to keep it out.
SIX! Short leg spinning delivery, Samiullah goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He is in a hurry!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Jacob Mulder is introduced into the attack!
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single. 15 runs off that over! 66 runs at the end of the Powerplay! Afghanistan now need 100 more to win!
Length delivery wide outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
FOUR! Again it's short of a good length, pulled handsomely over mid-wicket for a boundary. Shenwari on fire! Three boundaries in a row to start the innings!
FOUR! Was it a chance? Short and angling into the body, SS pulls it. Doesn't middle it and the ball falls just short of the short fine leg fielder and goes through to the fence.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, asking to be hit, Shenwari gets in a great position and slaps through covers for a boundary. Good start for the innings!
Fuller on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Samiullah Shenwari walks in at no.3!

OUT! Length delivery between middle and leg, Tarakai goes to heave it down the leg side for a biggie. He top edges it and the ball balloons in the air towards the area behind the stumps. Gary Wilson moves towards his right to pocket the skier. Tarakai has to make the long walk back to the hut after a quick cameo. Kevin O'Brien draws first blood.
Angling into the stumps, Tarakai stays in his crease and defends it well.
FOUR! THRASHED! Full and wide outside off, Tarakai slaps it powerfully through wide of mid off for a boundary.
SIX! BIGGIE! Half volley into the stumps, Tarakai stays in his crease and heaves it powerfully over the mid-wicket region. The ball goes long way into the stands for a maximum.
Full in the line of the stumps, Shahzad eases it towards long on for a single.
Angling into the pads, Tarakai clips it down the leg side for a single.
Short into the body, Shahzad goes for a pull but misses it. He gets hit on his body and the ball ricochets towards the point region. Shahzad calls for a single but he is sent back by the non-striker.
Tarakai cuts it through the point region for a single.
Dug in short! Tarakai ducks under it. The keeper does not collect it and the ball runs away towards the fine leg region. Two byes taken.
Angling into the pads, Shahzad clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Short and wide outside off, Shahzad slaps it over the covers region for a boundary.
Shahzad stays deep in his crease to defend it.
Another change in bowling! Craig Young now comes into the attack!
Good length delivery outside off, Tarakai again slashes at it but this time fails to make contact. The keeper gathers it and appeals for a caught behind. The umpire is not interested.
Angling into the stumps from a length, Tarakai stands deep in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Wide outside off, NT slashes his blade hard at it. Gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Tarakai slaps it through the cover region for a boundary. Good shot!
Anglng into the pads, Tarakai tries to clip it on the leg side. He misses the clip and the ball goes towards the fielder at short third man. Shahzad calls for a single but he is sent back by Tarakai.
Tarakai gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Change in bowling, as Kevin O'Brien is introduced into the attack!
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Shahzad dances down the track and slogs it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Powerful shot!
Quicker one into the pads, Shahzad again goes for a slog but misses it this time. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no as it was surely going down leg.
FOUR! Sprayed down the leg side! Shahzad sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. He seems to be in a mood to go big today!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angling into the pads, Tarakai clips it through the mid on region for a single.
SIX! Tarakai gets off the mark in style! Angling into the stumps from a fuller length, Tarakai stays in his crease and lofts it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. Classy shot!
George Dockrell to share the new ball!
Short delivery, MS stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shahzad stays in his crease and defends it well.
FOUR! Full into the stumps, Shahzad drives it down the ground through the mid on region for a boundary. First runs for Afghanistan.
Shahzad lunges forward in defence.
Tossed outside off, Shehzad cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Spinning into the stumps, Shahzad defends it off the front foot.

The players are back in the middle for the chase. Mohammad Shahzad and Najeeb Tarakai will open the batting for Afghanistan. Andy McBrine will start the proceedings with the ball for Ireland. 166 to chase, expect the Afghan openers to make full use of the Powerplay. Here we go!!!
